description: Returns comprehensive AI analysis for any US stock ticker: fundamentals (PE ratio, revenue, margins, market cap, ROE), technicals (RSI, MACD, moving averages, support/resistance, trend), sentiment score, and bullish/neutral/bearish directional assessment with confidence percentage. Analysis generated by Claude AI. Ticker parameter required. JSON format. Costs 5 credits per call.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol in uppercase, e.g. 'AAPL' for Apple, 'MSFT' for Microsoft, 'TSLA' for Tesla, 'NVDA' for NVIDIA. Use standard US ticker format.

name: get_stock_analysis
